name: owen-browser-bridge
description: Bridge browser captures into VS Code so GitHub Copilot can analyze tab data and screenshots.

languageModelTools.name: get_latest_browser_capture
languageModelTools.userDescription: Reads the latest browser capture received by Owen Browser Bridge.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when the user asks to analyze the current or latest browser, Defender portal, Entra portal, Azure portal, alert, screenshot, visible page text, or captured web page data. It returns the latest capture metadata, Markdown note, JSON payload, and screenshot path if available.

languageModelTools.name: get_browser_state
languageModelTools.userDescription: Reads the latest shared browser session state captured by Owen Browser Bridge.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when the user asks what browser page is currently shared, what Copilot can see on the page, what tab/session is active, or what the next browser action should be. It returns browserSessionId, tab metadata, latest capture paths, and a screenSummary with headings, landmarks, interactables, form fields, tables, viewport, and text sample.

languageModelTools.name: read_browser_capture
languageModelTools.userDescription: Reads a stored browser capture by id or path.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool to read a specific browser capture previously saved by Owen Browser Bridge. Provide either the capture id, JSON path, or Markdown path. It returns metadata, Markdown, JSON, and screenshot path if available.

idOrPath.description: Capture id, Markdown path, or JSON path. If omitted, the latest capture is returned.

languageModelTools.name: read_browser_capture_group
languageModelTools.userDescription: Reads all browser captures in a host or investigation group.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when the user asks to analyze all captures for a host, domain, portal, incident, alert, investigation, or capture folder. It returns the group metadata, group summary Markdown, ordered capture Markdown/JSON payloads, and screenshot paths for correlation.

group.description: Host, host/group folder, workspace-relative folder, absolute folder, or omitted to read the latest capture group. Examples: security.microsoft.com, security.microsoft.com/incident-12345.

languageModelTools.name: search_browser_captures
languageModelTools.userDescription: Searches stored browser captures by text, host, group, and date.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool to find prior browser evidence across investigation groups without reading every capture. It searches the local capture catalog by title, URL, host, group, id, and collected date.

query.description: Text matched against capture id, title, URL, host, and group.

host.description: Optional exact or partial host filter.

group.description: Optional exact or partial investigation group filter.

from.description: Optional inclusive ISO date/time lower bound.

to.description: Optional inclusive ISO date/time upper bound.

languageModelTools.name: browser_read
languageModelTools.userDescription: Runs read-only inspection and readiness actions in the paired browser.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Prefer this compact tool for page inspection, waits, target discovery, runtime snapshots, safety previews, and readiness checks. Use browser_act for uncommon advanced inputs.

url.description: Optional public page URL used to enrich rendered media results from the active paired tab.

mediaType.description: Media kind returned by mediaExtract. Defaults to all.

maxItems.description: Maximum deduplicated media results. Defaults to 100.

targetAgentId.description: Optional stable browser agent id when multiple paired browsers are active.

languageModelTools.name: browser_interact
languageModelTools.userDescription: Runs direct navigation and interaction actions in the paired browser.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use for click, type, navigation, scroll, history, tab, form, and rollback actions. effectPolicy=require can reject no-effect interactions.

targetAgentId.description: Optional stable browser agent id when multiple paired browsers are active.

languageModelTools.name: browser_workflow
languageModelTools.userDescription: Runs multi-step and reusable workflows in the paired browser.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use for journeys, pagination, conditional and bulk workflows, drilldown, macro replay, scenario execution, auth resume, and runWorkflow.

targetAgentId.description: Optional stable browser agent id when multiple paired browsers are active.

languageModelTools.name: browser_agent
languageModelTools.userDescription: Runs an evidence-aware, operator-supervised browser goal with planning and replanning.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use for goals that require multiple adaptive browser steps. The VS Code host observes, plans one action, verifies effects, detects loops, compacts context, and judges completion. Use operation=resume, get, or cancel with runId for lifecycle control.

operation.description: Run or resume a goal, read a stored run, or request cancellation. Defaults to run.

goal.description: Goal for operation=run. Optional override when resuming.

modelId.description: Optional VS Code language model id for planning and judging.

fallbackModelId.description: Optional fallback model used only for truncation, schema, parse, or timeout failures.

targetAgentId.description: Specific paired Edge/Chrome agent id when multiple agents are active.

languageModelTools.name: browser_evidence
languageModelTools.userDescription: Captures, validates, compares, and packages browser evidence.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use for screenshots, OCR hints, network and table evidence, visual assertions, claim checks, evidence packs, navigation graphs, and handoffs.

targetAgentId.description: Optional stable browser agent id when multiple paired browsers are active.

languageModelTools.name: browser_admin
languageModelTools.userDescription: Manages jobs, macros, templates, selector health, and review queues.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use for browser job lifecycle, macro recording, persisted scenario template management, selector health reports, and capture review queues.

targetAgentId.description: Optional stable browser agent id when multiple paired browsers are active.

languageModelTools.name: browser_act
languageModelTools.userDescription: Sends a safe action to the paired browser and returns the resulting page state.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when the user provides a URL to open or capture, asks Copilot to see/read the current browser screen, control the paired browser, click/type/wait/scroll, run multi-step workflows, inspect interactable elements, or capture resulting page state. For action=readPage it returns a structured screenSummary similar to an accessibility snapshot. Actions are executed by the paired browser extension through the local command queue and are limited to allowed hosts unless the user enabled Allow All Domains.

action.description: Browser action to run. Defaults to readPage.

targetAgentId.description: Specific active browser agent id. Required when multiple Edge/Chrome agents are connected unless owenBrowserBridge.preferredAgentId is set.

selector.description: CSS selector for click or type actions.

text.description: Visible text to click or wait for.

value.description: Non-secret text to type, option value to select, or key alias fallback. Password fields are refused.

urls.description: URL list for journeyCapture. Copilot can navigate each URL and collect per-page summaries.

formFields.description: Field name to value map for smartFormFill.

submitSelector.description: Submit button selector used by smartFormFill.

submitText.description: Submit button text used by smartFormFill when selector is omitted.

conditions.description: Conditional branches for conditionalWorkflow. Each item supports if/then/else steps.

linkText.description: Link text filter used by multiTabCrawl.

key.description: Keyboard key for keyPress actions, such as Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown.

role.description: ARIA role hint used to target elements, such as tab, button, menuitem.

label.description: ARIA label or title hint used to target elements.

index.description: Zero-based index when multiple elements match.

maxPages.description: Maximum page count for journeyCapture or paginateCapture. Clamped to 1-30.

maxTabs.description: Maximum tabs/pages to crawl for multiTabCrawl. Clamped to 1-30.

requiredFields.description: Required extracted field names for dataGapGuard.

acknowledgement.description: Optional operator confirmation token for high-risk actions. Use CONFIRM_BROWSER_ACTION.

nextText.description: Next page button/link visible text for paginateCapture.

extractSelectors.description: Named selector map for structured extraction. Example: { incidentId: '#id', severity: '[data-test=severity]' }.

waitAfterNavigateMs.description: Settle wait after page transition for paginateCapture. Clamped to 200-10000ms.

delta.description: Scroll distance in pixels for scroll actions.

options.description: Option values or labels for selectOption actions.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds, clamped between 1000 and 120000.

retries.description: Retry count for flaky UI operations. Clamped between 0 and 3.

fallbackSelectors.description: Alternative selectors used when the primary target fails.

fallbackTexts.description: Alternative visible text labels used when the primary target fails.

autoHeal.description: When true, failed DOM target actions inspect ranked visual/accessibility candidates and retry likely targets.

targetScope.description: Target lookup scope. auto traverses shadow roots and same-origin iframes when possible.

frameDepth.description: Maximum same-origin iframe traversal depth for target lookup.

retryProfile.description: Preset retry behavior profile when retries is omitted.

captureBeforeAfter.description: Capture lightweight before/after DOM diff metadata around the action run.

effectPolicy.description: Observe whether interactive actions changed URL, DOM, scroll, focus, or target state. require fails actions with no observed effect.

targetHint.description: Natural-language target hint used by inspectTargets or auto-healing target selection.

macroName.description: Workflow macro name for recordWorkflow and replayWorkflow actions.

params.description: Template parameters for replayWorkflow and runScenarioTemplate; replaces {{key}} placeholders in stored macro or scenario steps.

scenarioName.description: Built-in or custom scenario template name for runScenarioTemplate.

scenarioTemplates.description: Optional custom scenario template registry. Each value can include description, category, defaults, and steps.

templateVersion.description: Version label stored with saveScenarioTemplate, such as 1.2.0.

assertText.description: visualAssert passes when visible page text contains this value.

assertNoText.description: visualAssert passes when visible page text does not contain this value.

assertSelector.description: visualAssert passes when this selector is visible.

assertNotSelector.description: visualAssert passes when this selector is absent or hidden.

assertScreenshotChanged.description: visualAssert compares the current visual/text fingerprint with the previous assertion baseline.

selectorMemory.description: When true, successful remembered target selectors can be reused before ordinary fallback targets. Defaults to true.

watchDurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds for watchPageChanges. Clamped to 500-30000.

highlightSelectors.description: Selectors to draw evidence highlight boxes around for highlightEvidence.

highlightText.description: Visible text used to find evidence targets for highlightEvidence.

claim.description: Evidence claim to check against the current page for evidenceClaimCheck.

requiredClaims.description: Claims or evidence categories required for evidenceCompletenessCheck.

keyColumns.description: Column names used as stable row keys for tableWatchAndDiff.

waitCandidates.description: Wait condition names to profile for waitProfiler.

detailSelector.description: Detail panel selector used by guidedDrilldown after each matched row is opened.

contractName.description: Named page contract for assertPageContract, such as genericPortalReady, defenderIncidentReady, azureBladeReady, or entraTableReady.

contractSelectors.description: Selectors that must be visible for assertPageContract.

contractTexts.description: Visible text snippets required by assertPageContract.

captureGroup.description: Capture group or host/group path for buildEvidencePack or browserRunBundle.

jobName.description: Browser job name for startBrowserJob, getBrowserJob, and cancelBrowserJob.

tabRoles.description: Role-to-URL/title substring map for tabOrchestrator, popupGuard, returnToTab, and tabRunSummary.

expectedTabs.description: Expected tab count for popup and unexpected-tab detection. Clamped to 1-50.

returnToRole.description: Logical tab role to activate for returnToTab or after tabOrchestrator.

closeExtraTabs.description: When true, tabOrchestrator closes unexpected inactive tabs. Requires confirmDangerous=true.

onUnexpectedTab.description: How tabOrchestrator and popupGuard handle unexpected tabs.

regionX.description: Top-left X coordinate in CSS pixels for captureRegion.

regionY.description: Top-left Y coordinate in CSS pixels for captureRegion.

regionWidth.description: Region width in CSS pixels for captureRegion.

regionHeight.description: Region height in CSS pixels for captureRegion.

regionPadding.description: Optional padding in CSS pixels for captureElement or captureRegion.

targetTabIndex.description: Zero-based browser tab index for switchTab or closeTab actions.

confirmDangerous.description: Required for destructive actions such as closeTab.

captureAfter.description: Capture the resulting page state after the action. Defaults to true.

includeScreenshot.description: Include a screenshot in the resulting capture. Defaults to true.

includeHtml.description: Include an HTML snapshot in the resulting capture. Defaults to false.

investigationName.description: Optional group name for resulting captures.

durationMs.description: Capture duration budget for trace/download operations.

maxEntries.description: Maximum records returned by trace or extraction actions.

tableSelector.description: Target table selector for tableExtract. Defaults to the first table.

mediaType.description: Media kind returned by mediaExtract. Defaults to all.

checkpointName.description: Checkpoint name for stateCheckpoint and rollbackToCheckpoint.

includeFormState.description: Include form field values when creating a state checkpoint.

strictUrlMatch.description: When true, rollbackToCheckpoint fails if current URL does not match checkpoint URL.

reviewPrompt.description: Manual review instruction text for humanReviewGate.

matchMode.description: Match mode for bulkActionFromList text filtering.

actionTemplate.description: Template action applied to each matched item in bulkActionFromList.

maxItems.description: Maximum items processed by bulkActionFromList or returned by mediaExtract.

semanticConditions.description: Semantic wait expressions for semanticWait, e.g. text:, notText:, selector:, selectorGone:.

ignoreSelectors.description: Selectors ignored during run comparison reports.

policyProfile.description: Policy profile name for policyGuard, such as strict, standard, investigation.

preset.description: Named workflow preset for Defender incident navigation.

steps.description: Workflow steps used when action is runWorkflow. Each step can include action, selector/text targeting, waits, retries, and fallback targets.

wait.description: Wait condition object for action=wait. Example: { kind: 'element', selector: '[role=tab]' }

owenBrowserBridge.port.description: Localhost port used by the VS Code extension to receive browser captures.

owenBrowserBridge.captureDirectory.description: Workspace-relative folder where browser capture JSON, Markdown, and screenshots are stored.

owenBrowserBridge.captureDirectoryByPlat.description: Optional OS-specific capture directories. Keys use Node.js platform names such as win32, darwin, and linux. Aliases windows/win and mac/macos are also accepted. The matching platform path overrides owenBrowserBridge.captureDirectory.

owenBrowserBridge.allowedHosts.description: Browser page hostnames that the bridge accepts. Use an empty array to accept any host. Supports exact hostnames and wildcard suffixes like *.microsoft.com.

owenBrowserBridge.autoStart.description: Start the local browser capture server when VS Code finishes startup.

owenBrowserBridge.commandQueueMaxSize.description: Maximum number of pending browser commands. New commands are rejected when the queue is full.

owenBrowserBridge.preferredAgentId.description: Preferred browser agent id when multiple Edge or Chrome agents are connected. Leave empty to require targetAgentId when more than one agent is active.

owenBrowserBridge.captureRetentionDays.description: Delete capture files older than this many days after a new capture is stored. Zero disables age-based retention.

owenBrowserBridge.captureRetentionMaxIte.description: Keep at most this many indexed captures. Zero disables count-based retention.

owenBrowserBridge.redactionProfile.description: Redaction profile applied before browser capture JSON and Markdown files are stored.

owenBrowserBridge.customRedactionPattern.description: Additional JavaScript regular expression patterns applied to browser capture text before storage.

scripts.package: npm run package:vsix && npm run package:browser && npm run generate:checksums && npm run verify:release-assets
scripts.release:check: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test:protocol && npm run verify:actions && npm test -- --reporter dot && npm run package
scripts.release:local: npm run release:check && npm run install:local-vsix
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
